expected_findings.description: The test asserts user_input_fn is not None but lacks an identity check to verify it is the exact function passed in.
The function is not tested for the case where interactive=True but user_chat_input_fn=None, which should result in continuation_fn=None.
The log parameter should be grouped with other threading parameters like coordinator and event_log instead of being ordered after defaulted parameters.
The blank-line separator between rendered_system_prompt and instruction is hardcoded inline without documentation or a named constant.
